title: "First Overflights, 20 June - 5 July 1956" – U-2 routes over Eastern Europe
description: Map titled "First Overflights, 20 June - 5 July 1956" covering Europe from Norway and Finland to the Mediterranean, showing country borders and capitals. Solid, dashed and dash-dot lines trace the routes of "Mission 2003 20 June," "Mission 2009 2 July" and "Mission 2010 2 July" from Wiesbaden, West Germany, over Poland, East Germany, Czechoslovakia, Hungary, Romania and Bulgaria. Includes a kilometer/mile scale, a "Secret NOFORN" marking and handwritten page number "102."
